title: About Us - MrPaint
description: MrPaint is a local, family-run painting company, and has been servicing Sydney for over ten years. Find out more info about our friendly team.

headings.text: An established family company, MrPaint is a local business you can trust.

paragraphs: High Quality Painting Service for the Cairns Region

A contemporary company, MrPaint initially established itself as one of Cairns’ most sought after and popular Painting & Decorating contractors; a reputation that has stemmed from a philosophy of customer focus, superior workmanship, affordability, and professionalism.
At the start of 2024 we have relocated the family to Cairns and are now exclusively available to the good people of Cairns (and we couldn’t be happier!)

We can deliver everything from the simplest painting tasks to complex and intricate special finishes. MrPaint approaches every project, irrelevant of cost or size, with the aim to ensure we deliver a hassle free service from quoting to completion.
MrPaint achieves this through solid communication with clients, and a strong background in Project Management.
MrPaint has built an enviable reputation amongst the industry for consistently delivering high quality, Painting, Decorating, and Handyman services, across the Cairns.

The success of MrPaint is due to an awareness of what’s in vogue with market trends and a solid client focus. MrPaint reinforces this through blogging and solid marketing strategies that cater to customer needs.
MrPaint is fully insured and Work, Health and Safety compliant.
